verdict.rationale: AWS documents first-party bulk handling of resources: CloudFormation provisions everything described in a template, and deleting a stack removes all of its resources at once. Resource Groups can gather resources by tag or stack membership, and the CLI supports scripting across services. However, the evidence never shows a general-purpose batch action applied to an arbitrary set of items, such as running one operation against a whole tag-based group. Missing for 10: documented batch/bulk APIs or actions across arbitrary selected items, evidence that Resource Groups support bulk actions rather than just grouping, independent or hands-on corroboration.
